info.name: Data Primary Network UTXOs API
info.description: The Data API provides web3 application developers with multi-chain data related to Avalanche's primary network, Avalanche subnets, and Ethereum.

query.description: A comma separated list of X-Chain or P-Chain wallet addresses, starting with "avax"/"fuji", "P-avax"/"P-fuji" or "X-avax"/"X-fuji".
A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.
Asset ID for any asset (only applicable X-Chain)
The minimum UTXO amount in nAVAX (inclusive), used to filter the set of UTXOs being returned. Default is 0.
Boolean filter to include spent UTXOs.
Which property to sort by, in conjunction with sortOrder.
The order by which to sort results. Use "asc" for ascending order, "desc" for descending order. Sorted by timestamp or the `sortBy` query parameter, if provided.

variable.description: (Required) A primary network blockchain id or alias.

request.description: Lists UTXOs on one of the Primary Network chains for the supplied addresses.

response.name: Successful response
